code_notes.NYCOURTS: The Unified Court System is the judicial branch; courts are out of scope (growth plan).

code_notes.NYS Assembly: The Legislature is out of scope for nys (executive agencies).

code_notes.JCOPE: legethics.ny.gov is the Legislative Ethics Commission (Legislature); JCOPE itself was replaced by the Commission on Ethics and Lobbying in Government in 2022. projectsunlight.ny.gov owner unclear.

code_notes.CJC: Commission on Judicial Conduct (ny.gov lists it). A constitutional commission tied to the judiciary; not clearly an executive agency.
code_notes.NYWC: waterfront.ny.gov; ny.gov lists a 'Waterfront Commission'. The bi-state Waterfront Commission of New York Harbor and its New York successor need a decision before minting.

host_notes.my.ny.gov: The listing files my.ny.gov (the NY.gov ID login) under DOH.

code_notes.CC&F: ccf.ny.gov. The ny.gov directory names 'Council on Children and Families Services'; kjw8-pupa has no entry. Confirm the official name before minting.

code_notes.LIAFCU: liafcu.org looks like a credit union, not a government body.
code_notes.MVFCU: mohawkvalleyfcu.org looks like a credit union, not a government body.

code_notes.Department of Law: Office of the Attorney General (ag.ny.gov): statewide elected.
code_notes.Governor: Office of the Governor: a statewide elected office, not an executive agency. No government_level fits it yet.
code_notes.OSC: Office of the State Comptroller: statewide elected. Its listed hosts are program sites (grants management, open government, SFS); ecfsa.ny.gov is filed with the Erie County Fiscal Stability Authority instead.

code_notes.CJN: Hosts cjn.ny.gov and two justicecenter.ny.gov subdomains; no directory names a 'CJN'.
code_notes.DCB: deferredcompboard.ny.gov; no directory names a deferred compensation board.
code_notes.IOLA: iola.org; neither ny.gov nor kjw8-pupa names this body.
code_notes.PCFB: pcfb.ny.gov; neither ny.gov nor kjw8-pupa names this body.
code_notes.VDC: definedcontribution.ny.gov; no directory names this body. Possibly a program, not an agency.
